issues.reason: Categorical statements states that a definite/demonstrative/possessed plural ("his ... apologies") takes a group witness `(GroupOf <group> <kind>)`, so the singular `(Member sk_apology_1 apology)` is the wrong encoding for the possessed plural.

"sincere" is incidental description, not a fusing classifier, and the rule is explicit that a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol but always goes through the distributive rule over `(PartOf $x <group>)`.

`LocatedIn` is the entity-side head and `Location` the eventuality-side one — "the head *is* the event-vs-entity distinction" — and `sk_events_1` is a group of event-denoting nouns, which take event-side atoms (cf. "the event-noun's witness IS the eventuality").

The head half stands (same `LocatedIn`-on-eventualities error as index 2), but the dropped "elsewhere" is the reviewer's own registered coverage gap — an omission with no licensed carrier is not a defect, since nothing false or over-asserted remains.

gaps_confirmed: locative pro-form "elsewhere" — an unnamed place plus exclusion of the place just named has no licensed encoding
scare quotes / quoted wording inside a sentence ("sincere apologies") — no carrier records attributed rather than endorsed wording

pre-nominal occupational title ("Board Chairman Henny de Ruiter") — the title rule covers kinship/courtesy titles (title inside the Name string) and the appositive rule gives a host-tensed typing atom; which governs a positional title is unstated
new_gaps: a plural whose coordinated locative modifiers partition it ("events at Foodservice and elsewhere in the group") — there is no licensed way to split a group witness into sub-groups per modifier, so both locatives land on the one group
repair_summary: Retyped the possessed plural "his apologies" as a group witness `(GroupOf sk_apology_1 apology)`; replaced the group-level `(Member sk_apology_1 sincere)` with the distributive rule `(Implication (PartOf $x sk_apology_1) (Member $x sincere)) (STV 1.0 0.9)`; switched both locatives on the event group from `LocatedIn` to the eventuality-side `Location`.
notes: The name with its lowercase particle, the `board_chairman` genus with the noun modifier unexposed, the offer roles, the `For` oblique on the apology noun and the un-fused "embattled group" are all correct and untouched. "elsewhere" stays unencoded — removing content is the licensed response to a gap, inventing a carrier is not.
